verdict.rationale: Natural language is the product's primary interface. You describe a visual and Claude builds it (docs-13), then refine it through conversation, including group chats (docs-21, docs-4). It is usable from any Claude conversation (docs-15), sample prompts chain data pulls and PDF export (docs-16), and handoff to Claude Code takes a single instruction (docs-7). Hands-on users confirm building pages and assets by prompting (comm-6, comm-7, comm-17), though some report it needs repeated nudging (comm-4). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the command surface and its limits beyond marketing-level claims.
